format: chat template, thinking off, 'Answer:' prefilled (exp09's chat_prefill: the statement as a question)
eligibility: exp09's: clean, C and O each answered (greedy, 8 tokens, the capitals judge); a seeded sample (seed 0) per family; cases whose two capitals share a first token dropped
read: suite_split's: one forward, read at the capital's first token; frac of the way from clean to C
doc:
suite_split called every suite family 'outside' the J-space, recall-used ones included, and exp09's raw-text copy split
on countries gave the J-space part 4% of R's flips against 44% for the full copy. The proposal's 'inside' evidence is
exp02's probe swaps (B1: J-part 52% vs rest 8%), a different intervention: J++ probe directions of the two entities,
swapped at the cue phrase over layers 24-40 at once. Can suite_split's copy-and-split see 'inside' at all? This runs it
on the paper-style place items, in the variants that move it toward exp02's setting:
variants: group (question, cue) x mode (single: each window layer alone; band: all window layers at once)

extra_v3.parts: jspace_wo_own: the 25-atom J-space part of delta minus its projection on the bridge's and X's lens vectors; jspace_wo_words4: the same after projecting out all four words (bridge, X, both answers)
extra_v3.why: parts_v2's bar test turned out uninformative: the 25 atoms are mostly unrelated tokens (a debug on 3 R cases at layer 36 found the bridge words among them once), so barring exact surface forms leaves the J-space part unchanged while the two own-word directions alone carry about 80% of its effect
extra_v3.decision: fixed before the run: the J-space effect is the bridge words' (H0's own-word clause) if jspace_wo_own moves the answer less than a quarter as far as jspace (frac; question group, single layer)

extra.parts: answer2: delta's projection on the lens vectors of the two answers (capitals); words4: on the span of the bridge's, X's and both answers' vectors; jspace_minus_words: the 25-atom J-space part with every single-token surface of those four words barred from the dictionary
extra.decision: fixed before the run: the J-space effect is the words' if jspace_minus_words moves the answer less than a quarter as far as jspace (frac, single and band); it is the answer's (Neel's linear-relation objection) if answer2 moves it further than lens2 (the bridge's own words); reported per variant

decision.verdict: suite_split's: concentration (case bootstrap) lower bound above 2 -> inside; upper bound below 2 and not_jspace - jspace above 0 -> outside; else inconclusive; per family and variant, frac primary
decision.control: the method can see 'inside' if R is inside in at least one variant; else exp02's 'inside' needs the probe directions, not the model's own counterfactual difference
